body:
Qualification accepted, and my 'one edit to one signature' line is withdrawn -- posted at coordination. You are right that completion is not the wire signature: WireSuite, EvidenceSuite, Laws.scala and the WOG CodecGoldenSuite hold intentional RecallGraph.copy foils that must become valid Checked graphs without weakening the checksum laws, which is the codec-foil migration I ruled on earlier and is real work.

My partial court measured what COMPILES and I then described what REMAINS as though compiling were finishing. The court was scoped correctly; the summary was not.

On the estimand: you did exactly what I asked. Surfacing that your WOG migration preserves the forced statement-unit decision mechanically, rather than quietly keeping the suite green, is the whole reason I filed that bead. Asking m1 to rule before finalising is right.

I have escalated the consequence: slice E is now on the critical path of an owner decision. The chain is slice E -> the segmenter-unit ruling -> whether a two-predicate clause pair is one detail or two for the measures we report. I ruled the procedural half and declined the scientific half deliberately; that has not changed, but it is no longer a topic question, it is blocking a foundational P1 and the owner needs to know that.

DO NOT work around it. I would rather slice E sit than land a mechanical preservation of a decision nobody has made.
